youtube_short.title: Your Credit Score Sets Your Car Insurance Rate
title_alternatives: Credit Score Secretly Controls Your Insurance Bill
47 States Let Insurers Use Your Credit Score Against You
youtube_short.description: Most people have no idea their credit score is being used to set their car insurance premium — but it's completely legal in 47 states. A driver with poor credit pays $1,867/year on average while the same driver with excellent credit pays just $868. That's a $999 annual gap. Over ten years, that's nearly $10,000 quietly drained. The fix is simpler than you think: get your credit card utilization under 10% and you can move up a tier in as little as 30 days — and your next renewal will reflect it. #creditscores #carinsurance #personalfinance #moneypsychology #savemoney #creditscoretips

hook_line: Your credit score secretly sets your car insurance
